source_issues.finding: Opening attribution of all leaderboard/reproducibility failures to omitted statistics is source rhetoric. A measured difference alone does not show it is noise or real; narrative example and its numbers preserved.
source_issues.disposition: source statement faithfully preserved; not a required translation edit

source_issues.finding: Mean-median differences are not a universal skewness criterion; loss distributions being usually left-skewed is unsupported in source. Finite-sample percentile interpolation/tie conventions and even-count median convention are simplified. No translation correction introduced.
source_issues.disposition: source statement faithfully preserved; not a required translation edit

source_issues.finding: Bessel correction unbiasedness requires appropriate independent common-population/finite-variance assumptions and n>1; finite-population/descriptive conventions differ. Source sample/population denominators retained.
source_issues.disposition: source statement faithfully preserved; not a required translation edit

source_issues.finding: Pearson coefficient calculation does not require normality; certain significance procedures do. Denominator n*s_x*s_y requires compatible n-normalized deviations and conflicts with treating s as n-1 sample SD. Spearman y=x^3 strict rho=1 has tie/degenerate caveats; association types faithfully retained.
source_issues.disposition: source statement faithfully preserved; not a required translation edit

source_issues.finding: Covariance n versus n-1 convention must be coherent; standardized correlation division needs nonzero variances. PCA directions/variance and pairwise relationships are source simplifications, not a full information preservation statement.
source_issues.disposition: source statement faithfully preserved; not a required translation edit

source_issues.finding: Source p-value shorthand says as extreme/this extreme rather than spelling out at-least-as-extreme test-statistic tail. It is not probability H0 is true or proof a difference is real; translation preserves source wording. z=1.96 with estimated s is a normal/large-sample approximation, not universal exact mean CI; interval coverage interpretation in protected source is correctly retained.
source_issues.disposition: source statement faithfully preserved; not a required translation edit

source_issues.finding: Source paired example says same model but comparison later says both models; overlapping cross-validation training folds yield dependent scores, so ordinary paired t/Wilcoxon procedures need care. Using same test data is useful but source says different test sets make comparison meaningless too absolutely.
source_issues.disposition: source statement faithfully preserved; not a required translation edit

source_issues.finding: Chi-squared approximation requires valid expected counts/design and positive expected values. The two-count example arithmetic 8 and one-df p<0.005 are correct; no factual repair needed.
source_issues.disposition: source statement faithfully preserved; not a required translation edit

source_issues.finding: Practical importance depends on domain and cost; small percentage gains are not universally meaningless. Cohen d and cutoffs are contextual; population effect size differs from estimator sample-size bias. Source percent/percentage-point ambiguity deliberately not silently converted.
source_issues.disposition: source statement faithfully preserved; not a required translation edit

source_issues.finding: Expected count one with 20 null tests at alpha=.05 differs from certainty of any false positive. 1-(1-alpha)^m assumes independence. Bonferroni controls family-wise error without requiring independent tests, despite source narrow wording.
source_issues.disposition: source statement faithfully preserved; not a required translation edit

source_issues.finding: Bootstrap is not assumption-free or automatically valid for any statistic, dependence structure or small/rare data. Percentile intervals have coverage limitations; paired resampling indices correctly preserved. Blanket more robust than paired t statement is source overclaim.
source_issues.disposition: source statement faithfully preserved; not a required translation edit

source_issues.finding: Nonparametric tests retain independence/exchangeability/symmetry or distribution-shape assumptions. Rank tests are not generic substitutes for mean tests with identical null hypotheses; small n alone does not guarantee superiority.
source_issues.disposition: source statement faithfully preserved; not a required translation edit

source_issues.finding: CLT formulation is shorthand for normalized means/distributional approximation with finite variance and suitable dependence conditions; source later does include iid/infinite-variance/dependence caveats, which are preserved. n>=30/100 rules are heuristics, and stable CV/ensemble/SGD claims do not follow unconditionally.
source_issues.disposition: source statement faithfully preserved; not a required translation edit

source_issues.finding: Evaluating training data does not itself guarantee training overfit; lacking CIs does not logically ensure unreproducibility. Majority-baseline accuracy does not prove learning nothing, a 100-sample 2% gain is not necessarily pure noise, and fixed non-data-fit normalization need not leak. These absolute source warnings were not strengthened in translation.
source_issues.disposition: source statement faithfully preserved; not a required translation edit
